subject: Why does geom_bar calculate groupwise proportions?

messages.author: 06f6f7de05bef98c
messages.subject: Why does geom_bar calculate groupwise proportions?
parts: One of the variables calculated by geom_bar is a groupwise proportion (..prop..). Why is this calculated groupwise? If it is not overridden by the explicitly including the group aesthetic won't it always be equal to 1?
